Message.intro: In the name of Allah, who brings hearts together and fills them with love and mercy,
Message.invitation: With hearts full of joy and gratitude, and together with our beloved families, we are honored to invite you to share in the happiness of a day we have long awaited — a day on which we begin a new chapter of our story, hoping that its pages will be filled with love, companionship, and lasting grace throughout the years to come.
Message.presence: Your presence on this cherished occasion would mean more to us than words can express. It would become a beautiful part of a memory we hope to carry with us as we begin this new journey together.
Message.closing: We would be delighted to have you with us as we celebrate this precious beginning and write the first lines of a story we pray will become the most beautiful chapter of our lives. 🤍

today.title: Today
today.phrase: Today, we celebrate more than a single day… we celebrate everyone who brought us here, everyone sharing this moment with us, and everything we hope the days ahead will bring. 🤍

gratitude.title: Gratitude
gratitude.phrase: Before beginning a new chapter, we are grateful to everyone who was part of the chapters that brought us here.

theMoment.title: The Moment
theMoment.phrase: Some moments need no long description… they simply need to be lived with all our hearts.

presence.title: Presence
presence.phrase: Some people make a celebration more beautiful simply by being there… thank you to everyone who will be part of this memory.

dreams.title: Dreams
dreams.phrase: Shared dreams become more beautiful… because they turn from wishes into a life built day by day.

blessing.title: Blessing
blessing.phrase: May God bless this step and make what follows even better than what came before.

oneWeek.title: One Week
oneWeek.phrase: One week… and perhaps the most beautiful part is knowing that so many people are preparing to share our joy.

theJourney.title: The Journey
theJourney.phrase: What matters is not having a road without difficulties… but knowing we do not have to walk it alone.

love.title: Love
love.phrase: True love does not need many words; it reveals itself through presence and care.

tomorrow.title: Tomorrow
tomorrow.phrase: We do not know what the days ahead may hold, but we can welcome them with grateful hearts and good wishes.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.phrase: Knowing there is someone you can truly be yourself with… is a beautiful kind of security.

joy.title: Joy
joy.phrase: True joy becomes even more beautiful when there is someone to share it with.

goodCompany.title: Good Company
goodCompany.phrase: The best company is the kind that makes you more at peace with life and more grateful for it.

memories.title: Memories
memories.phrase: Some moments pass quickly, yet stay with us for many years.

aLifetime.title: A Lifetime
aLifetime.phrase: The beauty of life is not in the number of years, but in the people who make those years worth living.

differences.title: Differences
differences.phrase: We do not need to be alike in everything… it is enough to know how to differ and still remain close.

affection.title: Affection
affection.phrase: Affection is not just a word; it is found in the little things we do every day without expecting anything in return.

theFuture.title: The Future
theFuture.phrase: The future does not need to be perfect; it only needs to be filled with things worth experiencing together.

thoseAroundUs.title: Those Around Us
thoseAroundUs.phrase: Some people do not simply appear in our pictures… their presence lives in every beautiful memory.

gratitudeAt10.title: Gratitude
gratitudeAt10.phrase: Amidst everything we look forward to, there is already so much worth saying: Alhamdulillah.

family.title: Family
family.phrase: A day that brings two families together opens the door to a bigger family and more stories to share.

togetherness.title: Togetherness
togetherness.phrase: Life becomes lighter when you have someone to share its joys and carry its burdens with you.

serenity.title: Serenity
serenity.phrase: Not everything beautiful arrives with noise; some things come quietly and become an irreplaceable part of our lives.

laughter.title: Laughter
laughter.phrase: Having someone in your life you can laugh with over the simplest things… is a priceless blessing.

theLittleThings.title: The Little Things
theLittleThings.phrase: A beautiful life is not built only from grand moments, but from the little things that happen every day.

prayers.title: Prayers
prayers.phrase: Behind every great joy are countless wishes, some spoken aloud and others heard only by God.

familyAt3.title: Family
familyAt3.phrase: The beauty of celebrations is that they belong to more than two people; they bring many hearts together.

home.title: Home
home.phrase: Home is not walls and furniture… it is the place where we feel that we are never alone.

companionship.title: Companionship
companionship.phrase: Finding someone you feel at ease with along the way matters more than knowing where the road will lead.

beginnings.title: Beginnings
beginnings.phrase: Every beautiful story begins with a step… and some steps change an entire life.
